reported.title: Solenoid pulse is 1000 ms instead of 2500 ms
reported.description: PULSE_MS is defined as 1000 on line 7, but the spec requires a 2500 ms HIGH pulse. The pulse-end check on line 79 uses this constant, so every pulse ends after 1000 ms; measured evidence shows pulses lasting 1000 ms (e.g. 524 ms to 1524 ms) against an expected 2500 ± 150 ms. 8 of 8 pulse(s) had the wrong length: pulse from 524 ms lasted 1000 ms, expected 2500 ± 150 ms.

reported.title: Armed LED stays LOW for the whole (wrong-length) pulse window
reported.description: The LED is driven LOW at pulse start (line 75) and restored HIGH only when the pulse ends (line 83), so its state is tied to the pulse duration. Because PULSE_MS on line 7 is 1000 ms rather than 2500 ms, the LED is LOW for 1000 ms while D8 is HIGH, and the checker reports D11 was not HIGH for 1000 ms while required (e.g. 524 ms to 1524 ms). D11 was in the wrong state for 8000 ms across 8 interval(s), first at 524 ms: D11 was not HIGH for 1000 ms while required (grace 50 ms).

judge_input.spec:
- Trigger on D2 with INPUT_PULLUP (active LOW); glue solenoid on D8; armed LED on D11.
- A settled press as short as 30 ms starts a 2500 ms HIGH pulse on D8 within 120 ms.
- Retriggers during an active pulse are ignored.
- Debounce the trigger with 25 ms of stability.
- Keep D11 HIGH when idle and LOW while the solenoid pulse is active.
- Print `glue dots=<n> busy=<0|1>` every 500 ms.
